name: Fuhou Sounyuu -Ikesu no Juunin-
source:
Toru is an architect with high reputation. But he has a secret that he secretly installs the video cameras and microphones into the buildings to tap and peek, and rapes the girls in the end. He recently finished another work. There are beautiful girls, mother, sisters and a son's fiancee living in the house.... He starts to take an action as usual....

[From ErogeShop]
